title: GOD WILL RESTORE
YOUR WASTED YEARS
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: sunlit mountain valley at sunrise golden light
peaceful river flowing through sunlit green valley
ancient stone sanctuary table bathed in warm sunlight
golden wheat field under calm bright sunlight
sunlight breaking through morning mist over quiet stream
sunlit peaceful mountain path at dawn
calm mountain river under glowing morning sun

scenes.a: You still carry the weight of wasted years.
Hear the promise of the Lord in Joel chapter two.
And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
scenes.sub: I WILL RESTORE TO YOU THE YEARS

scenes.a: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
Lord, restore what seemed lost to fruitless struggle.
Fill our hands with Your daily provision. Deal wondrously with our labor, that we praise Your name.
Amen. You carry wasted years no more.
